'''2007 Endor Regionals D.J. Toby LS Rescue The Princess''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[D.J. Toby]] at [[2007 Endor Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself|SE-L-rescuetheprincess.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
